Also important: Rep Adam Smith, next Armed Services Committee chair, says a deep investigation of Trump's illegal boat bombings is coming. 

Crucially, defunding these boat strikes is also on the table:

newrepublic.com/article/2176...

Crucial: Rep Adam Smith, incoming chair of House Armed Services Committee, tells me Dems will vote to cut off funding for Trump's Iran war.

"I think it’ll be one of the first things we do," he says.

Importantly, he says this will have the support of Dem leadership:
